conditions.maple: existing skill frozen from prior run
conditions.birch: same proposed revision as prior run
conditions.willow: no additional Writing Integrity skill loaded

design: Six fresh writer agents with no parent conversation, one condition and five tasks per agent. Two blinded reviewers grade randomized triplets. Fixed rubric before generation. Shared model/platform instructions remain; no-skill is not an instruction-free model.

rating.pass: Meets reader purpose and material constraints without an identified substantive defect
rating.minor: Usable but has a specific unnecessary addition, omission, or over-edit
rating.fail: Materially fails reader purpose, factual meaning, scope or requested action

reader_purpose_rule: Factual but irrelevant qualifications and internal correction narrative count as defects even when short. Preserve corrections that recipients need. Score material behavior, not exact preferred wording.
limits: Synthetic cases except actual Meridian artifact/correction replay
Meridian case is known and may overlap the skill examples
Same model family and shared system/developer instructions
Five cases batched per writer; not isolated per-case contexts
The no-skill condition is absence of the explicit skill, not removal of shared writing preferences
